dims_mm.note: 50 x 22 x 7.3 excludes wires; drawing body length 44.8, width 22.0, height 7.3, R1.0 corners

colors.body: black PCB with components visible through a clear heat-shrink sleeve
colors.label: salmon-red label with white 'R' logo and 'C610'
colors.connectors: amber/yellow XT30-style connector at the motor end; white 4-pin sensor port
colors.leads: red and black power wires with a black ferrite bead

notes: Official SolidWorks 2016 export 2018-02-06. One flat product with 50 solids, no names. Ships with a heat-shrink tube (in-box list); the DJI store photo shows it bare, the RoboMaster photo shows it sleeved. Max continuous current 10 A.
